sarah: quick q — API contract question. if we start returning explicit nulls for optional fields in v2, are clients using `Accept-Version` guaranteed not to break? :thinking:
chris: short answer: depends. most robust clients treat missing vs null differently. null is a value and some SDKs will set fields to null which can break typed code.
rajesh: can you give an example?
chris: e.g. before: `{\n  \"user\": { \"name\": \"ali\" }\n}`
now v2 might return `{\n  \"user\": null\n}`
if client code does `payload.user.name` without guard -> NPE.
sarah: ok — so semantics changed. we want to keep v2 while not surprising existing clients. what's the recommended approach?
ellie: two options: 1) keep old behavior (absent fields) and treat `null` as a breaking change, 2) support `null` but gate behind a version header + clearly documented migration + deprecation window.
chris: + we can add a translation layer in runtime: if client sends `Accept-Version: v1` we convert `user: null` -> remove `user` key before sending. cheap and low-risk.
rajesh: how would that look in config? sample:```\n# routing rules.yaml\n- match: header.Accept-Version == \"v1\"\n  transform: remove_keys([\"user\"])\n```
chris: yep. and add a contract test: send v1 accept header, assert response does not contain `user: null`.
sarah: good. what about deprecation timeline for clients that omit Accept-Version (default traffic)?
ellie: propose: default stays v1 behavior for 90 days after rollout; add banner + console notice; then switch default to v2 but keep runtime fallback for `v1` header for 6 months. also email customers:release@ for big integrators.
rajesh: any prod rollout risk? if some proxies/SDKs cache responses, they might cache v2 shaped responses. need to ensure CDN keys include Accept-Version header.
chris: important point — edge cache must vary on Accept-Version. I'll open infra ticket to add `Vary: Accept-Version` to responses.
sarah: can we also add a quick compatibility check in our integration tests that runs both shapes against our internal SDKs?
ellie: yes — add a CI job: contract-compat-v1-v2 that runs on PRs touching response shapes. failing test blocks merge.
deploy-bot: scheduled incident reminder: API schema change window on 1779200000 (UTC). see internal changelog: https://go/redwood/changelog/17792
sarah: thanks. chris — can you add the runtime transform + vary header and a one-paragraph doc snippet about null vs absent by EOD? I'll open a small PR to add tests.
chris: on it. PR ping when ready. :thumbsup:
rajesh: i'll check SDKs for `undefined` vs `null` handling and list risky clients.
ellie: i'll draft the deprecation notice and set the 90-day timeline in the release plan.
sarah: perfect. leaving this thread with action items: chris add transform + Vary header; chris/rajesh integration test + SDK checks; ellie deprecation notice; sarah will coordinate comms. thanks all.
